IET 101: Mechanical properties of materials; primary processing methods used in manufacturing; ferrous and nonferrous metals; important plastic plus ceramic materials; dimensional verification and measurements; mechanical properties evaluation; laboratory methods; statistical interpretation of data.
IET 215: The study of manufacturing processes for the purpose of part creation and/or part feature creation using both current and advanced technologies.
IET 216: Laboratory methods in production design including conventional and advanced manufacturing processes, computer applications, and automation/robotics.
IET 297: Formal courses given infrequently to explore, in depth, a comparatively narrow subject which may be topical or of special interest.
IET 308: Fundamentals of probability and statistics, introduction to quality control fundamentals, control charts, acceptance sampling.
IET 311: Introduction to metallurgical concepts, metallurgical testing, phase diagram studies, heat treating concepts, ferrous and nonferrous systems.
IET 321: Manufacturing processes for producing metal, plastic, and ceramic items.
IET 333: Fundamentals of engineering economics; equivalence and rate of return analysis; replacement models; depreciation and tax considerations; and economic decision making for technologists.
